title: ‘Fiercely stubborn’: the US scientists continuing their research amid funding cuts
title_zh: ‘固执’：美国科学家在经费削减中继续研究
abstract: Researchers working on climate change, diversity, transgender health and international aid have turned to lawsuits, private donors and alternative topics to keep their projects going.
abstract_zh: 从事气候变化、多样性、跨性别健康和国际援助研究的科学家转向提起诉讼、寻求私人捐赠和转向其他主题，以维持项目的进行。
